review_kind: Independent model-based annotation review; not external human validation
provider: Ollama local / Meta Llama; original abstract notes generated/reviewed with Claude
inputs: Only public reviewer packet items; no expected labels, private map, seed, or audit results in requests.
primary: Candidate selection and every note label with source-grounded reasons. Keep all disagreements.
retry: At most one identical retry on invalid/incomplete JSON; no prompt modification or model selection based on agreement.
human_check: Separate eight-note author spot-check; not replaceable by model output.
